literary_form: anthology superscription and purpose prologue
deciding_marker_or_seam: The superscription opens the anthology; infinitival purpose clauses culminate in the fear-of-YHWH thesis at 1:7 before the first 'my son' address.
boundary_rationale: The superscription opens the anthology; infinitival purpose clauses culminate in the fear-of-YHWH thesis at 1:7 before the first 'my son' address.
rejected_alternative: Prov.1.1 alone would detach the title from its purpose statement.
defensible_basis: Low: explicit title-purpose closure; function, not chapter number, decides the seam.

source_observations.text: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

literary_form: parental instruction against a violent peer invitation
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'My son' opens direct instruction; the quoted enticement, prohibition, bird/net comparison, and consequence close together at 1:19.
boundary_rationale: 'My son' opens direct instruction; the quoted enticement, prohibition, bird/net comparison, and consequence close together at 1:19.
rejected_alternative: Splitting the sinners' quotation from the parental consequence would fragment one warning.
defensible_basis: Low: complete address and consequence.

source_observations.text: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

literary_form: personified Wisdom's public summons and refusal oracle
deciding_marker_or_seam: Wisdom becomes the named public speaker at 1:20; direct address, rejected call, reversal, and the secure-hearer contrast close at 1:33.
boundary_rationale: Wisdom becomes the named public speaker at 1:20; direct address, rejected call, reversal, and the secure-hearer contrast close at 1:33.
rejected_alternative: A break at 1:23 or 1:28 would sever summons from judicial consequence.
defensible_basis: Low: speaker and full speech frame are explicit; no ontology is decided.

source_observations.text: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

literary_form: single conditional parental instruction on seeking wisdom
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'My son, if' governs the chapter-length protasis; repeated 'then' results unfold as deliverance from two paths and conclude with the land contrast.
boundary_rationale: 'My son, if' governs the chapter-length protasis; repeated 'then' results unfold as deliverance from two paths and conclude with the land contrast.
rejected_alternative: Splitting at 2:9, 2:12, or 2:16 would detach coordinated results from their governing condition.
defensible_basis: T467 chapter-coincident hold: positive conditional syntax and land closure support the unit, but the exact scope of the two deliverance movements merits external review.

source_observations.text: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

literary_form: parental instruction chain on teaching, trust, honor, and discipline
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'My son' opens; paired imperatives and motive clauses move through trust and firstfruits to a final 'my son' discipline frame closed by the father-son comparison.
boundary_rationale: 'My son' opens; paired imperatives and motive clauses move through trust and firstfruits to a final 'my son' discipline frame closed by the father-son comparison.
rejected_alternative: Isolating 3:5-6 or 3:9-10 would extract famous maxims from their instruction chain.
defensible_basis: Medium: the sequence is linked rhetorically, though its sub-admonitions are partly detachable.

source_observations.text: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

literary_form: wisdom beatitude and creation hymn
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'Happy is the man' shifts to beatitude; value comparisons and tree-of-life imagery lead into YHWH's wisdom in creation, closing with the dew line.
boundary_rationale: 'Happy is the man' shifts to beatitude; value comparisons and tree-of-life imagery lead into YHWH's wisdom in creation, closing with the dew line.
rejected_alternative: Separating 3:19-20 would obscure the creation-grounded climax of the wisdom praise.
defensible_basis: Low: marked beatitude and praise movement.

source_observations.text: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

literary_form: parental instruction on wisdom-secured movement and sleep
deciding_marker_or_seam: The renewed my-son address governs preserving sound wisdom, whose neck ornament, safe walking, unafraid sleep, and freedom from sudden terror complete the security movement at 3:26.
boundary_rationale: The renewed my-son address governs preserving sound wisdom, whose neck ornament, safe walking, unafraid sleep, and freedom from sudden terror complete the security movement at 3:26.
rejected_alternative: Keeping 3:21-35 whole would obscure the turn at 3:27 from promised safety to a concrete catalogue of duties toward neighbors.
defensible_basis: The promises and neighbor duties remain adjacent within one parental instruction, so the selected child requires its 3:21-35 parent for retrieval.

source_observations.text: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

literary_form: neighbor-duty prohibitions with household verdict
deciding_marker_or_seam: The repeated do-not commands begin with withholding good at 3:27, proceed through neighbor conflict and envy, and resolve in paired YHWH verdicts on households and persons at 3:35.
boundary_rationale: The repeated do-not commands begin with withholding good at 3:27, proceed through neighbor conflict and envy, and resolve in paired YHWH verdicts on households and persons at 3:35.
rejected_alternative: Joining 3:27-35 to the safety promises at 3:21 would flatten a clear shift from second-person benefit to social obligation and divine evaluation.
defensible_basis: The list is rhetorically complete, yet it remains the ethical application within the larger my-son address that opened at 3:21.

source_observations.text: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

literary_form: intergenerational paternal instruction praising Wisdom
deciding_marker_or_seam: Plural 'sons' and 'listen' open a teaching frame; the father's remembered instruction and imperative to acquire Wisdom close with Wisdom's garland/crown promise.
boundary_rationale: Plural 'sons' and 'listen' open a teaching frame; the father's remembered instruction and imperative to acquire Wisdom close with Wisdom's garland/crown promise.
rejected_alternative: A seam at 4:3 would separate the remembered father from the teaching he transmits.
defensible_basis: Low: explicit audience, tradition frame, and closing promise.

source_observations.text: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

literary_form: two-ways parental instruction
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'Listen, my son' opens; guidance on wisdom's path is contrasted with the wicked path, ending in light/darkness antithesis.
boundary_rationale: 'Listen, my son' opens; guidance on wisdom's path is contrasted with the wicked path, ending in light/darkness antithesis.
rejected_alternative: Breaking at 4:14 would sever the opposed paths that form the instruction.
defensible_basis: Low: vocative and sustained two-path contrast.

source_observations.text: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

literary_form: body-and-path parental exhortation
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'My son, attend' reopens address; ear, eyes, heart, mouth, eyelids, feet, and path imperatives form a body catalogue closed by the command not to turn.
boundary_rationale: 'My son, attend' reopens address; ear, eyes, heart, mouth, eyelids, feet, and path imperatives form a body catalogue closed by the command not to turn.
rejected_alternative: Isolating 4:23 would detach the heart maxim from its governing body/path catalogue.
defensible_basis: Low: renewed vocative and coordinated body imagery.

source_observations.text: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

literary_form: complete parental warning and counter-instruction concerning illicit desire
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'My son' opens attention; danger, path consequences, direct avoidance, cistern/wife counter-image, and final YHWH-path consequence form one arc.
boundary_rationale: 'My son' opens attention; danger, path consequences, direct avoidance, cistern/wife counter-image, and final YHWH-path consequence form one arc.
rejected_alternative: Splitting at 5:15 would detach the positive counter-instruction from the warning it answers.
defensible_basis: T467 chapter-coincident hold: a complete warning-counterinstruction arc is visible, but inner movement seams are plausible.

source_observations.text: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

literary_form: brief parental rescue instruction about surety
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'My son, if' opens a conditional predicament; urgent imperatives culminate in gazelle/bird escape images.
boundary_rationale: 'My son, if' opens a conditional predicament; urgent imperatives culminate in gazelle/bird escape images.
rejected_alternative: Joining the ant saying would erase the completed surety-and-escape frame.
defensible_basis: Low: explicit condition and rescue closure.

source_observations.text: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

literary_form: sluggard address and ant observation
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'Go to the ant, you sluggard' changes addressee and example; rhetorical questions culminate in the paired poverty simile.
boundary_rationale: 'Go to the ant, you sluggard' changes addressee and example; rhetorical questions culminate in the paired poverty simile.
rejected_alternative: Separating ant observation from the sleep-and-poverty application would fragment the analogy.
defensible_basis: Low: named addressee and completed observation/application.

source_observations.text: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

literary_form: troublemaker body-part portrait and sudden downfall
deciding_marker_or_seam: A worthless person opens an embodied portrait of corrupt mouth, eyes, feet, fingers, heart, and sown discord; therefore sudden, irreparable calamity closes that portrait at 6:15.
boundary_rationale: A worthless person opens an embodied portrait of corrupt mouth, eyes, feet, fingers, heart, and sown discord; therefore sudden, irreparable calamity closes that portrait at 6:15.
rejected_alternative: Carrying the portrait through 6:19 would merge its therefore-climax with the separately numbered six-and-seven catalogue that begins at 6:16.
defensible_basis: Shared body and discord vocabulary link the two neighboring forms, but the explicit numerical reset supplies the stronger internal seam.

source_observations.text: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

literary_form: six-and-seven abomination catalogue
deciding_marker_or_seam: The graded six things, yes seven formula introduces a formal inventory whose seven members run from proud eyes to the person sowing discord among brothers at 6:19.
boundary_rationale: The graded six things, yes seven formula introduces a formal inventory whose seven members run from proud eyes to the person sowing discord among brothers at 6:19.
rejected_alternative: Absorbing the numerical list into 6:12-15 would conceal its explicit counting frame even though both units reuse body imagery and social discord.
defensible_basis: The catalogue is independently coherent as a numbered wisdom form without turning its shared vocabulary into a claim about source history.

source_observations.text: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

literary_form: parental instruction against adultery with legal-social consequence
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'My son' reopens instruction; bound teaching guides the son past seduction, fire/lap and burglary comparisons lead to the jealous husband's irreversible response.
boundary_rationale: 'My son' reopens instruction; bound teaching guides the son past seduction, fire/lap and burglary comparisons lead to the jealous husband's irreversible response.
rejected_alternative: Breaking at 6:27 or 6:30 would detach comparisons from the warning's social consequence.
defensible_basis: Low: vocative, sustained danger, and consequence closure.

source_observations.text: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

literary_form: parental instruction containing an observed seduction narrative
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'My son' opens and frames the command; the window observation, woman's speech, youth's capitulation, and renewed plural appeal close with the way-to-Sheol verdict.
boundary_rationale: 'My son' opens and frames the command; the window observation, woman's speech, youth's capitulation, and renewed plural appeal close with the way-to-Sheol verdict.
rejected_alternative: Extracting 7:6-23 as a standalone story would lose its parental frame and application.
defensible_basis: T467 chapter-coincident hold: the frame-narrative-appeal arc is positive evidence, while the embedded narrative is a plausible smaller unit.

source_observations.text: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

literary_form: Wisdom's public call and value invitation
deciding_marker_or_seam: Rhetorical questions announce Wisdom; public-location speech addresses humanity and closes with wisdom's incomparable value.
boundary_rationale: Rhetorical questions announce Wisdom; public-location speech addresses humanity and closes with wisdom's incomparable value.
rejected_alternative: Joining the preceding seduction appeal would blur the new public speaker and counter-invitation.
defensible_basis: Low: speaker and public summons are marked.

source_observations.text: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

literary_form: Wisdom's self-description through prudence, rule, love, and wealth
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'I, Wisdom' renews self-identification; first-person predicates form a coherent catalogue ending with filled treasuries.
boundary_rationale: 'I, Wisdom' renews self-identification; first-person predicates form a coherent catalogue ending with filled treasuries.
rejected_alternative: Splitting royal-rule statements from the surrounding first-person self-description would isolate one function.
defensible_basis: Medium: this remains part of the larger Wisdom speech.

source_observations.text: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

literary_form: Wisdom's first-person primordial/creation movement
deciding_marker_or_seam: The temporal 'before' sequence shifts to origins; repeated creation scenes culminate in daily delight before YHWH and humanity.
boundary_rationale: The temporal 'before' sequence shifts to origins; repeated creation scenes culminate in daily delight before YHWH and humanity.
rejected_alternative: Atomizing individual creation stages would mistake parallel temporal clauses for outer seams.
defensible_basis: Medium: translation and ontology pressures are substantial; the decision is literary scope only.

source_observations.text: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

hold.question: Should the primordial movement at Proverbs 8:22-31 surface only with compulsory 8:1-36 hydration, or remain an internal boundary that is never returned alone?

literary_form: Wisdom's concluding beatitude and life/death appeal
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'Now therefore, my sons' turns from self-description to conclusion; listen/blessed/finds-life versus sins-against-me/loves-death closes the speech.
boundary_rationale: 'Now therefore, my sons' turns from self-description to conclusion; listen/blessed/finds-life versus sins-against-me/loves-death closes the speech.
rejected_alternative: Joining Wisdom's banquet at 9:1 would erase this completed conclusion and the new third-person scene.
defensible_basis: Low: conclusion formula and terminal antithesis.

source_observations.text: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

literary_form: Wisdom's house-and-banquet invitation
deciding_marker_or_seam: Third-person Wisdom builds, prepares, sends, and speaks; the invitation closes with the imperative to live and walk in understanding.
boundary_rationale: Third-person Wisdom builds, prepares, sends, and speaks; the invitation closes with the imperative to live and walk in understanding.
rejected_alternative: Separating preparation from invitation would fragment a single banquet scene.
defensible_basis: Low: scene, emissaries, and quoted invitation.

source_observations.text: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

literary_form: responsive interlude on scoffer, wise person, and personal consequence
deciding_marker_or_seam: The banquet scene pauses for second-person maxims about correction; fear-of-YHWH and 'if you are wise' consequence close before Folly's new scene.
boundary_rationale: The banquet scene pauses for second-person maxims about correction; fear-of-YHWH and 'if you are wise' consequence close before Folly's new scene.
rejected_alternative: Absorbing the interlude into either woman's invitation hides its distinct correction-response function.
defensible_basis: Medium: speaker attribution and exact relation to the invitations are ambiguous.

source_observations.text: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

hold.question: Should Proverbs 9:7-12 be a neutral standalone gnomic interlude, or an internal child of 9:1-12 because its speaker remains uncertain?

literary_form: Folly's rival house invitation
deciding_marker_or_seam: 'The foolish woman' introduces a new seated caller; her stolen-water invitation ends with the narrator's death/Sheol disclosure.
boundary_rationale: 'The foolish woman' introduces a new seated caller; her stolen-water invitation ends with the narrator's death/Sheol disclosure.
rejected_alternative: Separating 9:18 would remove the narratorial reversal that closes the rival banquet.
defensible_basis: Low: new character, parallel invitation, and terminal disclosure.

source_observations.text: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

literary_form: Solomonic collection opening cluster on child, wealth, diligence, and harvest
deciding_marker_or_seam: The explicit 'Proverbs of Solomon' superscription opens; child/parent consequences move through profit and diligence to the wise/shameful harvest son.
boundary_rationale: The explicit 'Proverbs of Solomon' superscription opens; child/parent consequences move through profit and diligence to the wise/shameful harvest son.
rejected_alternative: Prov.10.1 alone would isolate the superscription-bearing saying and one-verse units would atomize the opening son/work chain.
defensible_basis: High seam uncertainty: catchword and role links are real but do not authorize collection history.

source_observations.text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

literary_form: contrast cluster on blessing, memory, mouth, and violence
deciding_marker_or_seam: Blessing and wicked-mouth violence recur at both edges; righteous memory and wise reception occupy the center.
boundary_rationale: Blessing and wicked-mouth violence recur at both edges; righteous memory and wise reception occupy the center.
rejected_alternative: One proverb per chunk would lose the mouth/violence envelope.
defensible_basis: High: aphoristic catchword clustering is contestable; retain named-collection parent.

source_observations.text: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

literary_form: speech-and-social consequence cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Hatred/love opens; lips, slander, concealment, speech abundance, and righteous lips/tongue repeatedly govern the sequence.
boundary_rationale: Hatred/love opens; lips, slander, concealment, speech abundance, and righteous lips/tongue repeatedly govern the sequence.
rejected_alternative: Isolating each bicola would erase the dense lips/speech chain.
defensible_basis: High: verses 15-16 broaden to wealth/wages within the chain.

source_observations.text: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

literary_form: YHWH-outcome and durable-righteousness cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: YHWH's blessing opens; wicked desire/fear and storm passing contrast with the righteous person's durable hope, days, and unshaken land status.
boundary_rationale: YHWH's blessing opens; wicked desire/fear and storm passing contrast with the righteous person's durable hope, days, and unshaken land status.
rejected_alternative: A chapter-end seam would interrupt the mouth/YHWH transition continued in the next unit.
defensible_basis: High: thematic rather than formal closure.

source_observations.text: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

literary_form: paired righteous-versus-perverse speech contrast
deciding_marker_or_seam: Mouth, tongue, and lips repeat across both bicola, contrasting produced wisdom and acceptable speech with a perverse tongue and perverse speech.
boundary_rationale: Mouth, tongue, and lips repeat across both bicola, contrasting produced wisdom and acceptable speech with a perverse tongue and perverse speech.
rejected_alternative: The rejected 10:31-11:1 bridge depends on generalized moral cadence, while 11:1 changes topic and imagery from speech organs to false and just measures.
defensible_basis: The explicit speech envelope closes at 10:32; chapter numbering is not the reason for the seam.

source_observations.text: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

literary_form: integrity, humility, righteousness, and deliverance contrast cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: False balance and just weight open an integrity evaluation that continues through pride and humility, integrity guidance, wealth failure, righteousness, and deliverance before mouth-based neighbor harm begins at 11:9.
boundary_rationale: False balance and just weight open an integrity evaluation that continues through pride and humility, integrity guidance, wealth failure, righteousness, and deliverance before mouth-based neighbor harm begins at 11:9.
rejected_alternative: Starting at 11:2 would detach the balance aphorism from its following integrity sequence, while attaching 11:1 backward would merge distinct speech and measurement forms.
defensible_basis: The thematic and lexical integrity chain is coherent but retains medium confidence because aphoristic cluster boundaries remain contestable.

source_observations.text: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

literary_form: speech, city, counsel, and surety social-order cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Mouth-based destruction/deliverance opens; city rejoicing, gossip/trust, counsel, and surety all concern social stability.
boundary_rationale: Mouth-based destruction/deliverance opens; city rejoicing, gossip/trust, counsel, and surety all concern social stability.
rejected_alternative: Splitting city/counsel from speech would lose their shared communal-order function.
defensible_basis: High: surety may begin a new sequence.

source_observations.text: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

literary_form: honor, kindness, violence, and character-result cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Honor/wealth introduces gendered character contrasts; kindness/cruelty, deceptive wages, steadfast righteousness, and the ring-in-swine image all evaluate character and outcome.
boundary_rationale: Honor/wealth introduces gendered character contrasts; kindness/cruelty, deceptive wages, steadfast righteousness, and the ring-in-swine image all evaluate character and outcome.
rejected_alternative: Isolating 11:22 as a memorable image would detach its character-evaluation role.
defensible_basis: High: loose anthology adjacency and translation pressure.

source_observations.text: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

literary_form: desire, generosity, fruit, and recompense cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Desire/outcome opens; giving and withholding lead to blessing, trust, flourishing, fruit, and recompense in the land.
boundary_rationale: Desire/outcome opens; giving and withholding lead to blessing, trust, flourishing, fruit, and recompense in the land.
rejected_alternative: Ending before 11:31 would weaken the repeated outcome/recompense closure.
defensible_basis: High: fruit vocabulary supports but does not prove the scope.

source_observations.text: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

literary_form: discipline, favor, household, and stability cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Love of correction opens; good/wicked favor, rooted righteousness, household shame/crown, and the house-standing contrast converge on stability.
boundary_rationale: Love of correction opens; good/wicked favor, rooted righteousness, household shame/crown, and the house-standing contrast converge on stability.
rejected_alternative: Chapter-sized or one-verse chunks would miss the rooted/house-standing movement.
defensible_basis: High: thematic cluster has no explicit superscription.

source_observations.text: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

literary_form: social estimation, work, compassion, and productive-root cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Praise/contempt opens; lowly productive work contrasts with pretension, cruelty, empty pursuits, and wicked desire, closing with righteous-root fruit.
boundary_rationale: Praise/contempt opens; lowly productive work contrasts with pretension, cruelty, empty pursuits, and wicked desire, closing with righteous-root fruit.
rejected_alternative: Separating work and root images would understate the productivity motif.
defensible_basis: High: compassion vocabulary interrupts a tight work chain.

source_observations.text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

literary_form: speech, truth, counsel, and concealment cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Lip transgression opens; mouth fruit, fool/wise counsel, rash/healing words, truthful/lying lips, deceit, and prudent concealment dominate.
boundary_rationale: Lip transgression opens; mouth fruit, fool/wise counsel, rash/healing words, truthful/lying lips, deceit, and prudent concealment dominate.
rejected_alternative: One proverb per unit would erase the sustained speech vocabulary.
defensible_basis: Medium-high: 12:15-16 adds counsel/anger but remains speech-response related.

source_observations.text: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

literary_form: diligence, anxiety, guidance, and life-path closing cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Diligent versus lazy hand opens; anxious heart and good word, neighbor guidance, sloth/diligence, and the righteousness path culminate in life.
boundary_rationale: Diligent versus lazy hand opens; anxious heart and good word, neighbor guidance, sloth/diligence, and the righteousness path culminate in life.
rejected_alternative: The chapter boundary is retained only because the life-path line provides a positive collection cadence.
defensible_basis: T467 chapter-coincident risk: local life-path closure exists, but 13:1 may continue instruction contrasts.

source_observations.text: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

literary_form: instruction, mouth, appetite, diligence, and guarding-righteousness cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Wise son/discipline opens; mouth fruit and guarding lead into appetite/diligence, lying, and righteousness guarding the way.
boundary_rationale: Wise son/discipline opens; mouth fruit and guarding lead into appetite/diligence, lying, and righteousness guarding the way.
rejected_alternative: A seam at 13:3 would detach guarded mouth from guarded conduct.
defensible_basis: High: son formula may merely be another independent aphorism.

source_observations.text: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

literary_form: wealth, ransom, light, pride, and incremental gain cluster
deciding_marker_or_seam: Rich/poor reversal opens; wealth as ransom, righteous light, pride contention, and diminishing versus gathered wealth share possession/outcome concerns.
boundary_rationale: Rich/poor reversal opens; wealth as ransom, righteous light, pride contention, and diminishing versus gathered wealth share possession/outcome concerns.
rejected_alternative: One-verse units would obscure the repeated wealth/outcome vocabulary.
defensible_basis: High: light and pride sayings weaken thematic unity.

source_observations.text: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

literary_form: desire fulfilled, instruction, prudence, and consequence cluster
